description: This file is a React component written in TypeScript that acts as the main page of a web application. It manages application state related to connections, projects, and user interactions, and incorporates various subcomponents like Sidebar, ConnectionForm, ConnectionStatus, and ProjectsList. The code handles fetching connection statuses, testing connections, storing credentials, disconnecting, and loading projects, with user interface logic for different states (initial, connected, disconnected).

methods.name: loadConnectionStatuses
methods.description: Fetches and updates the connection status for all services.

methods.name: handleStoreCredentials
methods.description: Stores user credentials for a service and loads projects if connection succeeds.

methods.name: handleTestConnection
methods.description: Tests the connection for a specific service type.

methods.name: handleDisconnect
methods.description: Disconnects from a service and clears related project data.

methods.name: loadProjects
methods.description: Loads projects or spaces for a given service type.

methods.name: getConnectionStatuses
methods.description: Returns current connection statuses for 'jira' and 'confluence'.

methods.name: renderMainContent
methods.description: Renders the main content area based on current application state.
